evaluation_target: reviewer component only, not end-to-end RAG

model_settings.sampling_parameters: omitted from connector request; provider defaults and drift unknown, not deterministic

execution.max_calls_formula: sum(1 + c_i), c_i=1 for every planned initial request
execution.stop: first execution/transport/storage/final contract failure; record later items as unexecuted; no semantic rerun
execution.budget_deadline_formula_seconds: 180 * planned_initial_requests; budget admission deadline, not a guarantee of exact wall-clock abort

report: planned versus attempted versus valid coverage by source/topic/type
sample_order.interpretation: Early-stop completion depends on order; valid prefix is not representative of all planned holdout samples. No extrapolation or order-dependent reruns to improve reported results.

alignment.reference_units: freeze original semantic reference units before predictions; program carriers are not denominators
alignment.semantic_review: AI assisted, user supervised; record text vs file/SHA verification scope separately
alignment.split_merge: equivalent scoped statements may align jointly, reference counted once
alignment.mixed_compound: mixed labels or partial equivalence unaligned; no favorable-subclause selection or automatic collapse
alignment.extra_predictions: report separately; no reference denominator inflation
alignment.rationale: cannot repair missing conditions in evaluated answer; retain label/rationale tension
alignment.basis_ids: identity match alone is not evidence support

holdout_rules.group_by: original document and lineage, including translations, mirrors and near duplicates
holdout_rules.ambiguous_reference: resolve before predictions or hold with reason; no automatic removal after outcomes
holdout_rules.results_used_to_modify_protocol: batch becomes subsequent development; preserve original outcomes, replace source groups next version

open_before_batch: batch-specific original label definitions and guarded mapping provenance confirmed; candidate adoption is not blanket label conversion approval
new source lineage review and owner excerpt/range approval
questions, premises, evidence identity, requirements and all reference labels confirmed
reference semantic units, ambiguity policy, sample list/order and matching plan finalized
batch-specific runner/source/message/config/reference hashes and budgets frozen
known_limitations: coverage still can mix correctness with addressedness
exception omission interpretation needs pre-prediction annotation decision; current developer dispute remains
strict JSON and unit rationale can fail after correction
single local correction success does not demonstrate stability
adoption_scope: User text adoption with two requested clarifications: definition-qualified legacy mapping and pre-fixed order/coverage reporting. Not API permission or final batch freeze.

support_mapping_guard.not_supported: Map only when original definition explicitly means lack of evidence support and separates contradiction. If it mixes contradiction or is ambiguous, do not convert; hold or independently annotate/version before prediction.
definition_provenance_required: semantic interpretation and exclusion of contradiction
pre-prediction owner confirmation for the batch

historical_definition_example.definition_summary: not_supported means evidence insufficient, not automatically factually wrong; contradicted separately means explicit conflict with selected text
historical_definition_example.scope: Historical example only; does not license mapping unrelated datasets or settle individual exception-interpretation disputes.

support_mapping_guard.unknown_or_mixed_labels: Do not infer from names, guessed synonyms or observed predictions. Unknown/supported/contradicted/not_assessable also require original semantic definition compatibility.
